content:
**Poached Angler** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Angler meat that has been cooked over a fire. It gives a 30 minute boost to maximum AP while restoring a large amount of HP and hunger at the cost of a negligible dose of rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Angler Meat (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Angler Meat | | Poached Angler (1) | 

- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after having picked up Angler Meat for the first time.
- May be sold by Mr Waiter and Ms Waitress inside the Whitespring Resort.
